description: Delete from your durable memory. This cannot be undone. Give a node's stem and --block ID to delete one block. Give only the stem to delete the node; a node that has children is refused unless you add --recursive, which deletes it and everything under it. Links to what you deleted are not rewritten: the result lists each one as dangling, with the node and block that holds it, so you can rewrite those blocks. Delete what is wrong or no longer matters; to correct a claim, replace the block's text instead. Examples: ["outbox-etiquette", "--block", "m-7f3a2k"], ["old-plan"], ["old-plan", "--recursive"]. If the command exits with code 75 ("busy" or "changed on disk"), run the same command again.
